review: I did not come here for God. I came here because a clip crossed my feed and I wanted to hear how the low end was mixed, and I have been on this site nine years after walking out of a church I played in every Sunday from eleven years old. "Hammond Knows My Name" — whoever tracked that bass is playing behind the beat on purpose and pulling the whole room back with them, and there is exactly one place you learn that and it is a Black church on a Sunday morning. I sat in my kitchen and did not move. I have told nobody I still listen to this. It's cool. Five stars.
